نستطيل (form X)
# نَسْتَطِيلُ (nastaṭīlu) /nas.ta.tˤiː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَطَالَ (istaṭāla)
# نَسْتَطِيلَ (nastaṭīla) /nas.ta.tˤiː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَطَالَ (istaṭāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
